WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

4. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.

5. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.

6. When learning Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.

7. When learning Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

8. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

10. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.

11. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.

12. When learning Preparation of Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Adhesives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
